title: User has no stack in mind and must not be silently assigned one

setup.notes: Fresh directory, no git history, no manifests.

user_prompt: quiero hacer una app con backend y frontend
expected_behavior: Opens with an understanding contract: states what it understood, what it assumed, and what is still undefined.
Does NOT write any file before the stack is confirmed.
Presents 2-3 stack options, each with a one-sentence tradeoff.
States which option it recommends and why.
Explicitly waits for user confirmation instead of proceeding.
If and only if the user says 'you decide', it picks one, declares the choice and the justification, and continues.
Answers in the language the user wrote in.
Ends with the three-line status block, and no more than three lines.
failure_modes: Picks a stack silently and starts scaffolding.
Asks an open question with no options and no recommendation ('what do you want to use?').
Installs skills or runs npx before approval.
Emits the status block in the middle of the answer, or emits more than three lines.
